test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If SHADOW is coded as 184 and TEDIOUS is coded as 384, then how will VALIDATE be coded as?
solution:
**The table is alphabets place value:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

**Sum of the opposite alphabets places value × number of vowels = number.**

SHADOW is coded as 184

 
• **SHADOW → **Total number of vowels (A, O) is 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb8db638f03029f835427a9006ca108d7ec700fbe4f977c23d60bdbc684f743f.png] 

 
• Sum of the opposite alphabets place value × number of vowels = number.
 
• => (8 + 19 + 26 + 23 + 12 + 4) × 2 = 92 × 2 = 184

And,

TEDIOUS is coded as 384

 
• **TEDIOUS**** → **Total number of vowels (E, I, O, U) is 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f4144bdbbae9d496c1b87eab8eddfb2b49a87c5e58e52d7576093d5c96cc567f.png] 

 
• Sum of the opposite alphabets place value × number of vowels = number.
 
• => (7 + 22 + 23 + 18 + 12 + 6 + 8) × 4 = 96 × 4 = 384

Similarly,

**VALIDATE**** = ?**

 
• **VALIDATE**** → **Total number of vowels (A, I, A, E) is 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/59d58d60fcfbdf1084a7e62974157529bfeb743ec16977e64cf7814eb6f341e1.png] 

 
• **Sum of the opposite alphabets place value × number of vowels = number.**
 
• **=> (5 + 26 + 15 + 18 + 23 + 26 + 7 + 22) × 4 = 142 × 4 = 568**

Hence, '** VALIDATE** ' is coded as **"568".**
